payload.summary: Finish the Railway Caring Contacts clean-up that #P00HDB left open: worker service, SUPABASE_CARING_CONTACTS_* and deploy/australia
payload.detail: Split from #P00HDB, which closed on 2026-09-26 on the owner's check that the production Database service has no CARING_CONTACTS_* variables. #P00HDB's re-scoped detail also asked for three more things that were not confirmed: (1) whether any SUPABASE_CARING_CONTACTS_* variables exist on the production Database service, (2) the same two prefixes on the production worker service, and (3) that no Railway service builds from deploy/australia. The Caring Contacts code is gone (PR #3098), so nothing can use these values any more. The risk is leftover credentials: any database address or secret found is a credential to rotate or revoke, not just delete. NEXT ACTION (owner, in the Railway dashboard, project Database, production): look at the Database and worker services' variables for either prefix, and at each service's source settings for deploy/australia. Delete anything found, then rotate or revoke any credential. Record the result here; a clean result closes this row in one line.
payload.source: Split from #P00HDB after a Codex review of PR #3112, 2026-09-26
